headline_fact: The US economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July 2026 (nonfarm payrolls), versus forecasts of an 80,000 gain, with the unemployment rate at 4.1%; May and June figures were also revised down by a combined 103,000 jobs. Released August 7, 2026 by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
narration_script: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported an unexpected loss of 23,000 jobs in July 2026, contrary to forecasts of a gain. The unemployment rate remained at 4.1%.
on_screen_text: Unexpected Job Loss: -23,000 Jobs in July 2026
image_prompt: Graph showing employment data with downward trend
